# DSH Feishu Session Control

Canonical repository: https://github.com/jason-namehard/dsh-feishu-session-control
Maintainer: 见川
License: AGPL-3.0
Compatibility package name: dsh-lark-bot
Verified target: DeepSeek Harness 0.1.2-rc.1
Last updated: 2026-09-09

This project is a fork of PlutoKeating/dsh-lark-bot. It retains upstream copyright and AGPL obligations while
adding an in-process DSH host adapter, integrated Web session management, stable MMDD-N aliases, recycle-bin and
permanent deletion, and explicit half/full Feishu attachment modes.

Canonical behavior:

- Sessions created in DSH Web are detached from Feishu by default.
- The first ordinary message in a Feishu chat creates and attaches a dedicated DSH session in half mode.
- /use <alias> switches without replaying history and uses half mode.
- /switch selects half or full mode.
- Half mode returns only Feishu-origin turn results; independent Web/TUI turns are not mirrored.
- Full mode also mirrors new Web/TUI messages and replies in the attached session.
- /detach removes only the Feishu attachment and preserves the DSH session.
- /delete moves a session to the recycle bin after confirmation.
- /purge permanently deletes a session after confirmation.
- The plugin adds no per-tool approval gate. It mirrors only native DSH approval requests; Web or Feishu approval
  is sufficient.
- Stopping DSH stops Feishu. There is no Guardian, safe-mode takeover, automatic start, or automatic restart.
- Group chats consume new events only; they do not inject complete chat history on every turn.
